name: Alaric Kesset
desc:
Alaric Kesset is an Adretian Navy Captain serving in [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) navy, serving as captain of the CASS 'Shallow Grave'. They had previously fought in conflicts in the Eastern and Etrean Luminants.

Kesset was assigned to Operation 'Distant Light', where the 'Shallow Grave' carried out reconnaissance on the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles). The operation was a success, and Kesset reported their findings to Fleet Admirial [Thorm Erebet](entity:thorm_erebet).
